Players Committee card image of [[Scarif: Data Vault (ALT) (Errata)|Scarif: Data Vault (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “'''Light Side:''' While opponent occupies, Stardust (and any character it is on) may not move from here. '''Dark Side:''' All immunity to attrition (and Ephant Mon's game text) here is canceled.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/scarifdatavault_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/69b48d5906370abc197be89533853ee63ff8cb86 69b48d5] (19 February 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
